# Releases
## @vercel/otel@2.2.0

### Minor Changes

- [#225](https://github.com/vercel/otel/pull/225)
[`33f8cc1`](https://github.com/vercel/otel/commit/33f8cc145d74cd899b15403c1f51641fdae06d7b)
Thanks [@kakadiadarpan](https://github.com/kakadiadarpan)! - Add time
limits to span exports.

- OTLP export requests now abort after 10s by default, on any platform.
Before, they had no timeout. Change it with `timeoutMillis` on
`OTLPHttpProtoTraceExporter` or `OTLPHttpJsonTraceExporter`, or with
`OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_TIMEOUT` and `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT`.
`@vercel/otel` now reads those env vars, in milliseconds, so `10` means
10ms.
- On Vercel, the span flush queued in `waitUntil` gives up after 10s.
Change it with the new `flushTimeoutMillis` option in `registerOTel`.
- An export that fails before sending reports the failure right away
instead of stalling for 30s.

### Patch Changes

- [#230](https://github.com/vercel/otel/pull/230)
[`9a69a11`](https://github.com/vercel/otel/commit/9a69a11e5b254158aaa5c2094acdd1bb468ebffe)
Thanks [@kakadiadarpan](https://github.com/kakadiadarpan)! - Fix
[CVE-2026-54285](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf) in
the baggage propagator, which `registerOTel` uses by default. Inbound
`baggage` headers are now capped at 180 entries and 8,192 bytes, and
entries over 4,096 bytes are skipped. Before, every entry was parsed,
however large the header.
